title: Great Quality for the Price!
text: Great Quality for the Price!. I did quite a bit of research on storage containers as this was my first time using.  I looked as several well known stores that had similar products but were way more expensive.  For the price of these, I figured if I didn't like them, it wouldn't be a huge loss. When I removed them from the box, I was initially disheartened because I didn't think they would hold enough.  Boy was I wrong!  I quickly filled up all the containers and realize I need more.  The labels aren't paper stickers, but thicker and stick well. My pantry looks SO much better and I can't wait to get more of this brand.  I guess their design might take up a bit of space but it's nothing compared to the space I've saved without all the boxes and bags in my pantry!  I can't wait to get more!
